Deloitte NLA | Analyst Trainee | Fresher | NLA 3.0 | March 2024 | Off-Campus
**Status:** Fresher 2024, BTech CSE Tier 3
**Position:** Analyst Trainee at Deloitte
**Time Taken:** From December 2023 to March 2024 
**Opportunity:** Off-Campus
**CTC:** INR 4.5LPA 

---
#### Interview Process
1. Applying on the Deloitte NLA3.0 portal:- [website link](https://deloitteconsultingnla.hirepro.in/engineeringhiring.html)
2. Resume based shortlisting
3. Online Assesment
4. Online Interview

---
#### Online Assesment
This test was conducted around mid of Feb 2024
**Platform Used:** Hirepro
TEST DURATION: 90 Minutes
NUMBER OF QUESTIONS:
* 65 questions in the Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQ) format
* 2 questions in the Live Programming/Coding format

4 Sections:
1. English (13q)
2. Aptitude (22q)
3. CS Fundamentals(30q)
4. Coding(2q)

Q.1 To print from n to 1 (reverse order)
```python
def solve(n: int) -> void:
	for i in range(n,0,-1):
		print(i, end=" ")
```
Q.2 Given time in 12 hr clock format, find the smallest angle between the hour hand and minute hand
```python
def solve(h: int, m:int) -> int:
	hour_angle = 0.5 * (h * 60 + m)
    minute_angle = 6 * m
    angle = abs(hour_angle - minute_angle)
    angle = min(360 - angle, angle)
	return\xA0angle
```

---
#### Online Interview
**Platform Used:** Hirepro
After 15 days, i have received the interview mail.
I searched on the deloitte archives for this role the final interview round is a mix up of Technical and HR round. I was interviewed by a Senior Product Manager.

It started with my basic introduction and then she asked questions about my skillset which includes ai, ml & python and secondly about my projects related to tech stack, difficult phase, need and it's outcome. 
After that, she moved onto the coding part, it starts with the time complexity of all searching algorithms and finally ended with the practical implementation of **Bubble sort**. I explained both the brute as well as optimal approaches for the same.
Finally, as the time was still remaining she proceeded with a puzzle kind of question, in which i was told to answer that how many auto-rickshaws are present in your city.
**My Experience:** Overall, the experience was good. If one gone through the archives and previous interview experiences, then he/she will be good to go.

---
#### Final Verdict

Deloitte NLA Experience
Deloitte Conducted National Level Assesment (NLA) this Year in January Month.
The hiring process is divided in 5 parts : 

**1.  Registration**
**2.  Shortlisting (Generally Resume Shortlisting)**
**3.  Online Assesment**
**4.  Interview (Technical + HR)**
**5.  Result Declaration**

The ctc offered through NLA is **4.5** LPA 

The registeration was started in January 1st week and I also have registered in the same week.

After that shortlisted candidate got a mail for next round which is **Online Assesment** and I got the same on 16 of January.

After that Deloitte send the mail for slot confirmation mail in which we have to confirm our slot to appear in the Online Assesment and I have confirmed my slot on the very first day (you got a choice in which day you want to give exam and the exam are conducted nearly 7 days on three different timings. You can choose between them). 

My assesment was on 18 of January at 9:30 PM. I have appeared in the assensment.
**The assesment is of 90 minutes**
It containt questions related to Aptitude, Verbal Ability, Logical reasoning and Computer Basics as well as programming logics. This is all about only 60 minutes of test, another 30 minutes is for coding round which contain only two programming questions. You have multiple language options like C, C++, Python, Java, etc. **The 1st coding question was of easy level and 2nd was mordrate** I solved both question under 20 minutes only :)

I got the mail for **Personal Interview round** on 3rd Feburary and for interview slot confirmation mail on same day. My interview was on 6th of Feburary at 10:50 AM.
**Interview Experience**, My interview lasts for 30 minutes. In those 30 minutes, Interviewer asked me multiple questions related to C++(because I have mentioned in my introduction, that C++ is my domain language) and after that some questions on JAVA and MySQL(as it is mentioned in my resume).
She asked me two basic coding questions (may be just to check my confidence and typing because questions were very easy): 
1. Swap two numbers without using 3rd variable 
2. To print one statement in Multiple languages (in C, C++, Python, Java. I have done in 4 Languages).
**The interview was good at my level and I have answered all the questions. The panalist also suggest me what to do next**

I got the result on 22nd of March and I go
